title: Network map
description: A map of your devices and the links the access rules allow; a line does not mean data is flowing.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ID or network address…

vault.dialogDesc: Enter the password to show the hidden groups and the devices in them. Without it they stay hidden.

canvas.hint: Drag the background to move and scroll to zoom. Select a device or a line to see its details; drag a device to move it.
canvas.cutExplain: Blocking creates a rule that stops the two devices exchanging data, in both directions.
canvas.needsOverlayIp: To block this connection, both devices need a network address. Check the device details.
canvas.cutFailed: The connection was not blocked. Try again shortly. If it continues, contact the network administrator.
canvas.restoreFailed: The connection was not unblocked. Try again shortly.
canvas.confirmBody: Two blocking rules are added, one for each direction, so the two devices cannot exchange data.
canvas.partial: Only one direction was blocked. Open Access rules and remove rule {{id}}, or try again.
canvas.restorePartial: Some blocking rules are still there: {{ids}}. Try again.

policyOpenNotice: The rules allow links between all devices, except blocked ones. Communication also needs an available path.

empty.title: No devices yet
empty.desc: No devices match the chosen sub-network or filters. Try changing them.
empty.enrollFirst: Connect your first device from My devices and it will appear here.

graph.scopedCounts: Counts include only the devices your account can see.
graph.policyOnly: Shows allowed links, not the paths actually used.
graph.neighborLimit: Showing the first 50 connected devices. Use search or the list to see all.

single.title: Only one device so far
single.body: Connect another one to see how your devices reach each other.

legend.kindNote: A profile device is a phone or computer with a WireGuard profile; it reaches the network through a gateway.
legend.notMeasured: Direct and relayed paths are not measured yet, so they show “—”.

notice.dense: The rules allow almost every connection, so the map shows only the exceptions.

mirror.label: Devices on the map
mirror.help: Use the arrow keys to move between devices, Enter to open the details and Escape to close them.
